title: Soundness of the first nonconstant monomial
statement: Let $r,\ell\in\mathbb{N}$, and assign a coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each monomial indexed by a subset of $\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$. If there is no nonconstant monomial with nonzero coefficient, then the polynomial represented by these coefficients is the constant function whose value is the coefficient of the empty monomial. If there is such a monomial, the Boolean function obtained by evaluating the polynomial and encoding its values as signs has positive influence in the least coordinate of the first nonconstant monomial selected by the specified rule.
hypotheses_covered: A coefficient assignment to all monomials of degree at most $\ell$
